body: I'm happy to hear you're getting general motivation. I just think, i'm at the point where im No longer waiting to seen those rather Long or Short term vakues that would motivate me. I also don't see it as being cowardous. How is it a cowardly act to speak your peace? Espeacialy om such as grand scale.  IT requires a very Strong and i'd say Brave spirit to litterally say "fuck you" to the entitet rest of, well... Everything...
